AGENDA
  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  MUNICIPAL SERVICES BUILDING – 633 E. Broadway, Room 105
  Glendale, CA 91206
Welcome to the meeting of the Design Review Board. Meetings are broadcast live on cable channel 6 (GTV6) and rebroadcast throughout the week; program schedules
are available by calling (818) 548-4013. DVD’s of the proceedings are available for purchase in the City Clerk’s Office. Meetings are also archived on the City Website
for viewing anytime at www.ci.glendale.ca.us/video_archives.asp. If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for assistance, please contact the
Community Development Department at (818) 548-2115 during regular business hours.

PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE HEARING ROOM.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request.
Assisted listening devices are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required for requests regarding sign language translation
and Braille transcription services. All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are public
records, will be available for review in the Community Development Department, 633 E. Broadway, Municipal Service Building RM 103, Glendale, CA 91206.

  Thursday, April 11, 2019, at 5:00 PM
  I.  Roll Call: Arzoumanian, Boyajyan, Benlian, Malekian, Simonian
  II. Report Regarding Posting of Agenda: The agenda for this meeting was posted on the bulletin board outside City Hall at or before 5:00 p.m. on
  April 4, 2019.
  III. Oral Communications: Discussion is limited to items NOT a part of this agenda. Each speaker is allowed 3 minutes. The Board may question the
  speaker, but there will be no debate or decision. The Board may refer the matter to the proper department’s section for investigation and report.
  IV. Review Calendar:
  A.  Staff Announcements:
  B.  Design Review Cases:
  DRB Case No.  Address  Applicant  Planner  Project  Last Reviewed
  a.  PDR1901418  1220 Alameda Ave.  H. Sadekyan  K. Duarte  New 1-story SF  --
  1.  DRB Record of Decision to Approve Final Project Design
  Environmental Determination: The project is exempt from environmental review per State CEQA Guidelines Section 15303, Class 3
  New Construction or Conversion of Small Structures” because the project involves construction of one single-family residence.

  b.  PDR1708693  3510 N. Verdugo Rd.  H. Zohrabians  V. Zemaitaitis  New 3-Story Mixed Use  --
  1.  DRB Record of Decision to Approve Final Project Design
  Environmental Determination: A Negative Declaration was adopted by the Planning Hearing Officer on September 11, 2018, for
  Variance Case No. 1708690 for the project.

  c.  PDR1819378*  1304-1310 S. Brand Bl.  W. James  R. Kiesel  New Automobile Dealership  --
  1.  DRB Record of Decision to Approve Final Project Design
  Environmental Determination: A Mitigated Negative Declaration (MND) was prepared for the project and circulated for public comment
  February 13, 2019 – March 5, 2019 (20-day review). The DRB must consider the MND prior to making a determination on the project.

 V. Approval of Minutes: January 24, 2019 and February 14, 2019

 VI.  Adjournment

 NOTES:
 1)  PARTICIPATION: Applicants will be allotted 5 minutes to explain their projects; other interested parties will be allotted 3 minutes to speak
  at the discretion of the Chairperson, with a 2 minute rebuttal for the applicant. The Chairperson may alter the order of agenda items.
 2)  APPEALS: There is a 15-day appeal period for decisions rendered by the Design Review Board.
 3)  REPORTS ONLINE: Staff reports and their respective attachments are accessible through hyperlinks in the “Agendas and Minutes” section of
  the City website: www.glendaleca.gov. The case file and copies of plans may be viewed in the Community Development Department,
  Municipal Service Building, Room 103.
